title: Rabbanai Choza’i
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: Mentioned in Beitzah 15b as “Rav Tachlifa, brother of Rabbanai Choza'ah.” Dikdukei Soferim cites “Rav Tachlifa, father—and some say brother—of Rabbana Choza'ah.” So too in the Rif, the Rosh and Shibbolei HaLeket, division 2, section 16.

notes.text: The alternative relations are father and brother of the same named Rabbanai/Rabbana. The names and variants remain separate attestations.
The consulted Beitzah passage reads “brother.” The father alternative and its attribution to the other works are Hyman’s reports.
